stdout:
USAGE:
    fur settings db-servers add [OPTIONS]

OPTIONS:
    -h, --help                Prints help information                           
    -n, --name                Server name (unique identifier)                   
    -H, --host                Database host address                             
    -p, --port                Database port. Default: 5432                      
    -U, --username            Database username                                 
    -d, --databases           Comma-separated list of specific databases        
        --ssl-mode            SSL mode (Disable, Allow, Prefer, Require,        
                              VerifyCA, VerifyFull)                             
        --timeout             Connection timeout in seconds                     
        --max-parallelism     Max degree of parallelism                         
        --fetch-all           Auto-discover all databases on server             
        --exclude-patterns    Comma-separated patterns to exclude from          
                              auto-discovery
notes: o Mustel acrescenta `-i/--interactive` e `-W/--password` (decisão do usuário)
